I DO NOT RECOMMEND this service at all.

My loan number: MUMEE00572808

At the beginning, when I was applying for a loan, everything felt very supportive. I was getting constant calls, regular follow ups, and full assistance. It honestly felt like they really cared. But the moment the loan was disbursed, everything changed completely. It was like I did not exist anymore.

When I needed help to make a partial repayment and requested to transfer the loan to my account, no one answered my calls. I kept trying again and again and was completely ignored. This situation caused me extreme mental stress. I am the only person responsible for repaying this loan and handling all my finances after losing my father. I have no backup and no support, and still no one from the team even bothered to respond.

My assigned agent, Abhishek Awate, was absolutely useless. He never answered my calls and never helped me even once when I genuinely needed support. It felt like once their job was done, they just disappeared. I raised a grievance three times and still got no response at all. Not even a basic acknowledgement. It was beyond frustrating and honestly very upsetting.

I felt completely stuck and helpless dealing with this company. In the end, I had no option but to transfer my loan to IDFC Bank last year just to get out of this horrible experience.
If you are planning to study abroad and thinking about taking a loan from this company, please think again. Do not put yourself through this kind of stress, frustration, and complete lack of support.

If anyone wants to know more about my experience, you can reach out to me. But please do not make the same mistake I did.
